# Compile-risk list — Phase 1 `:app` (consolidated)

Generated 2026-10-15 by the unattended Phase-1 cloud run, branch `phase1/all`. `:app` has **never been
compiled**: the cloud VM has no Android SDK, and the Android SDK licence is Johannes' decision. This file lists
every AndroidX, Compose, Room, DataStore, OkHttp and Keystore symbol that the Phase-1 `:app` code relies on, with
the reason each one is believed to exist in the versions pinned in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. It merges the
three package lists (WP-06, WP-07, WP-08) with the three static consistency-pass groups that re-read every `:app`
file against the compiled `:core` API.

Note: the WP-06/07/08 lists were written before WP-03/04/05 landed. Where an entry says a `:core` symbol is "not yet on
disk", the consistency pass has since checked it against the real `:core` API.

## How the `:app` code was checked without an SDK
- **WP-06** type-checked every file in a throw-away JVM Gradle project. It used real OkHttp 5.5.0, okio,
  coroutines 1.11.0, kotlinx.serialization 1.11.0 and Kotlin 2.4.10, with hand-written stubs for Android, Room
  and DataStore. 69 JVM tests passed there: MappersTest, SettingsMappingTest, HttpErrorMapperTest and RetryPolicyTest.
- **WP-07 / WP-08** compiled their ViewModels and tests against the real `:core` sources, and their Compose
  screens against JetBrains Compose Multiplatform 1.8.2 desktop jars. Android-only APIs were stubbed (`R`,
  `stringResource`, navigation, lifecycle). The ViewModel tests passed against stubs of the WP-03/04/05 services.
  `CoachViewModelTest` was compiled but never run.
- **Consistency pass**: 34 + 98 + 45 files were read by hand against the final `:core` API (now compiled and tested).
- None of this replaces a real build. When something below fails on the first `:app` compile, use the fallback
  given in that entry.

## First things to look at on the first `:app` build
1. Room KSP: `@Transaction` on concrete suspend functions in DAO *interfaces* (`PlanDao.saveCurrent`,
   `WorkoutDao.supersede`). Fallback: turn the DAO into an `abstract class`.
2. Material3 1.4.0 chips (`FilterChip`, `InputChip`, `AssistChip`): every use carries
   `@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)`, so an annotation that is no longer needed is only a warning.
3. `Icons.Filled.Chat` / `Icons.Filled.ShowChart` in the frozen `nav/BottomBar.kt` are deprecated in favour of the
   `AutoMirrored` versions. This is a warning only; the build does not set `allWarningsAsErrors`.
4. The unit-test classpath needs `androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel`. It comes in through `lifecycle-viewmodel-compose`.
5. Commit `app/schemas/com.gymcoach.app.data.db.AppDatabase/1.json` after the first build (Room schema export).


## WP-06 — data, network, secure storage

- Room 2.8.4 (room-runtime + room-compiler via KSP 2.3.11): androidx.room.Entity(tableName, indices), Index(value = [...], unique), PrimaryKey, ColumnInfo(name), Dao, Insert(onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE/ABORT), Query, Update, Transaction, Database(entities, version, exportSchema), RoomDatabase, Room.databaseBuilder (AppContainer), androidx.room.migration.Migration. All exist since Room 1.x/2.0.
- Room DAO shapes: suspend functions and Flow return types (in room-runtime since 2.7, when room-ktx was emptied, R2 §6.4); a projection data class with @ColumnInfo (ExerciseLastLogged); Boolean bind parameters.
- Room @Transaction on concrete suspend functions inside a DAO interface (PlanDao.saveCurrent, WorkoutDao.supersede) is copied verbatim from §7.1. It relies on Room's Kotlin code generation (KSP default since Room 2.7, 'room.generateKotlin' = true). Fallback if KSP rejects it: turn the DAO into an abstract class.
- Backticked `key` column in ProgressionDao.get (`WHERE `key` = :key`): SQLite accepts the identifier quoting.
- DataStore Preferences 1.2.1: androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore(name) property delegate on Context; androidx.datastore.core.DataStore.data; androidx.datastore.preferences.core.{Preferences, Preferences.Key.name, MutablePreferences set/remove, stringPreferencesKey, intPreferencesKey, emptyPreferences, edit}. Stable API since 1.0.
- OkHttp 5.5.0 + okio 3.x: OkHttpClient.newCall, Call.execute/enqueue/cancel, Callback.onFailure/onResponse, Request.Builder().url/header/post/build, RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody(ByteArray, MediaType), MediaType.Companion.toMediaType, Response.code/isSuccessful/header(name)/body/use, ResponseBody.string()/source(), okio.Buffer, BufferedSource.read(Buffer, Long), Buffer.readByteArray(). All compiled and ran against the real okhttp:5.5.0 JVM artifact in the scratch harness. Response.body is non-null in 5.x, so the code assigns it to a ResponseBody? local to stay 4.x/5.x-neutral. The Android variant okhttp-android exposes the same API.
- Android Keystore (API 23+, minSdk 26): android.security.keystore.KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(alias, purposes).setBlockModes/.setEncryptionPaddings/.setKeySize/.build; KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, PURPOSE_ENCRYPT, PURPOSE_DECRYPT, BLOCK_MODE_GCM, ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE; java.security.KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore"), getEntry, SecretKeyEntry; javax.crypto.KeyGenerator.getInstance(alg, "AndroidKeyStore"); Cipher "AES/GCM/NoPadding"; GCMParameterSpec(128, iv). This is R2 §6.1 verbatim.
- java.util.Base64 (API 26) for the iv/ciphertext strings; minSdk is 26.
- ConnectivityManager: Context.getSystemService(Class) (API 23), activeNetwork (API 23), getNetworkCapabilities (API 21), registerDefaultNetworkCallback (API 24), unregisterNetworkCallback (API 21), NetworkCallback.onAvailable/onCapabilitiesChanged/onLost, NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED (API 23). The ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission is already in the WP-01 manifest.
- android.content.res.AssetManager.open(String) and android.util.Log.w(String, String): platform API since API 1.
- kotlinx-coroutines 1.11.0: callbackFlow, awaitClose, trySendBlocking (since 1.5), suspendCancellableCoroutine, sync.Mutex/withLock, Dispatchers.IO, flow.catch/onEach/first/map/distinctUntilChanged, MutableStateFlow.update. Verified on JVM.
- kotlinx-serialization 1.11.0: serializers generated for every @Serializable enum (SessionStatus.serializer() etc.), PlanMutation.serializer() as a sealed polymorphic serializer with classDiscriminator "type", ListSerializer/MapSerializer, JsonPrimitive.intOrNull, the jsonObject/jsonPrimitive extensions. Verified on JVM.
- :core symbols that are not yet on disk (coded against their SPEC signatures, see needs_from_others): com.gymcoach.core.planner.Planner and Normalized; com.gymcoach.core.progression.{ProgressionEngine, AfterSessionInput, DeloadPolicy, DeloadSignals, DeloadTrigger}; com.gymcoach.core.coach.wire.{SseParser, SseEvent, RequestBuilder}.

All of these compiled against Compose Multiplatform 1.8.2 (M3 1.3-level API); only version drift to 1.4.0 is untested.

- androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel: ScopedViewModel overrides protected open fun onCleared() (ViewModel.onCleared has been protected open for years; JVM stub in the scratch project only).
- R.string.* ids: every id used by WP-07 is defined in strings_training.xml or Phase-0 strings.xml (checked by script: zero undefined); stringResource(id, vararg formatArgs) positional %1$s/%1$d placeholders match the call sites (Int args for %d). Names are prefixed per screen to avoid duplicate-resource clashes with strings.xml and WP-08's strings_setup.xml.

Largest files: SessionViewModel.kt 399 lines, TodayViewModel.kt 399, TodaySections.kt 386.
- Runtime assumption to verify on a device: SessionViewModel.tick runs a 1 s ticker coroutine while the screen is alive (tickMillis = 0 disables it in tests); RestBar uses System.currentTimeMillis() while the VM stores clock.now() millis, which is the same clock in production (SystemClock).

## Consistency pass — data + network + di

- androidx.room:room-runtime and room-compiler 2.8.4 (KSP 2.3.11): @Database/@Entity/@Dao/@Query/@Insert/@Update/@Transaction/@ColumnInfo/@Index/@PrimaryKey, OnConflictStrategy, Room.databaseBuilder(Context, Class, String).addMigrations(vararg Migration).build(), androidx.room.migration.Migration. All are long-standing APIs. room-ktx is not needed since 2.8.0, and suspend and Flow DAO methods are in room-runtime.
- Room: `@Transaction open suspend fun` inside `@Dao abstract class` (PlanDao.saveCurrent, WorkoutDao.supersede) is the documented pattern. Suspend and Flow return types in abstract DAO classes are supported.
- Room: the Boolean bind parameter in `(:includeArchived = 1 OR archived = 0)` and `(:includeSuperseded = 1 ...)` is stored as INTEGER 0/1. `IN (:ids)` with List<String> is supported. The projection class ExerciseLastLogged is a data class whose @ColumnInfo names match the SELECT aliases. ProgressionStateEntity has a column named `key`; Room escapes it in generated SQL, and the hand-written query quotes it with backticks. The columns `date`, `at`, `status` and `kind` are not reserved words in SQLite.
- Room: ProfileEntity and NutritionStateEntity use `@PrimaryKey val id: Int = 1` (Kotlin default argument, still a plain constructor for Room). Schema export needs the ksp arg room.schemaLocation, which is set in app/build.gradle.kts; the schemas/ directory is created at the first build.
- androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences 1.2.1: preferencesDataStore(name) as a Context extension property delegate, Preferences.Key<T>, stringPreferencesKey, intPreferencesKey, emptyPreferences(), DataStore<Preferences>.edit { prefs -> prefs[key] = v; prefs.remove(key) }, and the `.data` Flow. All have been stable since 1.0. The IOException handling is the documented `.catch { if (it is IOException) emit(emptyPreferences()) else throw it }` pattern.
- Android framework (compileSdk 37, minSdk 26): ConnectivityManager.activeNetwork (API 23), getNetworkCapabilities, registerDefaultNetworkCallback (API 24), unregisterNetworkCallback, NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED, NetworkCallback.onAvailable/onLost/onCapabilitiesChanged(Network, NetworkCapabilities), Context.getSystemService(Class) (API 23), AssetManager.open, java.util.Base64 (API 26), KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(alias, purposes) with setBlockModes/setEncryptionPaddings/setKeySize/build, KeyProperties.*, and the AndroidKeyStore provider with KeyGenerator.getInstance("AES", "AndroidKeyStore"). ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE is declared in the manifest.
- OkHttp 5.5.0 and Okio 3.18.1: OkHttpClient.Builder with connectTimeout/readTimeout/callTimeout(Long, TimeUnit); Request.Builder().url(String).header().post(); ByteArray.toRequestBody(MediaType?) via RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody; String.toMediaType(); Call.execute()/enqueue(Callback)/cancel(); Response.code, isSuccessful, header(name), body; ResponseBody.string()/source(); Response used with kotlin.io.use (Closeable); okio.BufferedSource.read(Buffer, Long) and Buffer.readByteArray(). I compiled this code against okhttp-jvm 5.5.0 and okio-jvm 3.18.1. The :app module gets okio transitively through okhttp (api scope), so no extra dependency is declared.
- kotlinx.coroutines 1.11.0 and kotlinx.serialization 1.11.0: callbackFlow, awaitClose, trySendBlocking(...).getOrThrow(), ProducerScope.channel.close(), suspendCancellableCoroutine with invokeOnCancellation, Flow.catch/first/map/onEach/distinctUntilChanged, MutableStateFlow.update, Json.parseToJsonElement and JsonObject/JsonArray constructors. All compiled against the real jars.
- Unit tests: only MappersTest, HttpErrorMapperTest and RetryPolicyTest were run on the JVM. SettingsMappingTest needs androidx.datastore.preferences.core.Preferences at JVM test time; the AAR resolves on the unit-test classpath, and the test touches no Android framework class (SettingsMapping lives in the same file as SettingsDataStore, which uses android.util.Log, but the Log class is never loaded).
- AppContainer is a Phase-0 contract file that I did not edit. It uses bound references `::backend`, `::planner`, `::progressionEngine` and `::deloadPolicy` to member functions as factory arguments. They compiled in my stubbed compile with Kotlin 2.4.10.

**Fixes applied by this pass:**

- app/.../data/db/Daos.kt: PlanDao and WorkoutDao changed from @Dao interface to @Dao abstract class, with abstract on every query/insert/update method and open on the two @Transaction methods (PlanDao.saveCurrent, WorkoutDao.supersede). Reason: Room's documented form for @Transaction methods that have a body is an abstract class. A Kotlin interface default body depends on DefaultImpls / -jvm-default handling in Room 2.8.4 with Kotlin 2.4. Callers are unaffected: AppDatabase.planDao()/workoutDao() and the Room*Repository classes use the same names and signatures.
- app/.../data/db/Daos.kt: MetricsDao.activeQuestions parameter renamed from `on` to `onDate` (SQL bind :on to :onDate), because `on` is an SQL keyword. The repository calls it positionally, so nothing else changes.
- Static check beyond reading: I compiled the whole group with the real Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler against :core's compiled classes and the real kotlinx-serialization 1.11.0, coroutines 1.11.0, OkHttp 5.5.0, Okio 3.18.1 and kotlin-test/junit jars, using small hand-written stubs for the Android, Room and DataStore APIs. Compiled: Entities, Daos, AppDatabase, Migrations, all Room*Repository classes, Mappers, EnumNames, DocVersions, InMemoryUnreadableDocs, AssetKnowledgeSource, KeystoreCipher, KeystoreApiKeyStore, DataStores, SettingsDataStore, AndroidNetworkMonitor, DirectApiBackend, BridgeBackend, NotConfiguredBackend, SseBodyReader, HttpErrorMapper, RetryPolicy, AppContainer, PlanCoordinator, GymCoachApp, and all four test files. Result: no errors or warnings.
- Ran MappersTest, HttpErrorMapperTest and RetryPolicyTest on the JVM: 63 tests, all pass. SettingsMappingTest compiled but was not run, because it needs the real DataStore Preferences classes.
- Checked: every `import com.gymcoach.core.*` in the group resolves to an existing declaration on disk. AppContainer's constructor calls match :core (named arguments to CoachTurnService and PlanCoordinator included). The `when` over BackendError in RetryPolicy and over BackendMode in AppContainer is exhaustive. There is no androidx.room or okhttp3 import under ui/. The group references no R.* resources; the `backend_key_rejected` string that KeystoreApiKeyStore's comment mentions exists in strings_backend_policy.xml.

**Unresolved / read-only checks:**

- AppContainer.backend() builds `DirectApiBackend(okHttp, apiKeyStore)` without `settingsRepository`, so DirectApiBackend.test() always pings the default model instead of the model selected in Settings. AppContainer is a Phase-0 file I may not edit. Fix for the integration step: `DirectApiBackend(okHttp, apiKeyStore, settingsRepository)`.
- MainActivity.kt was not compiled, because it needs Compose and the ui/nav files. Read by hand: AppNavHost(container: AppContainer, navController: NavHostController) and GymCoachTheme(content) match the call sites, and enableEdgeToEdge, setContent and rememberNavController are standard. MainActivity does not observe unreadableDocs, although the AppContainer comment says it shows the 'newer app version' banner. That is a UI-group item.
- Not checked beyond reading: Room KSP SQL validation and schema export, and the real AndroidX signatures (DataStore edit/data, ConnectivityManager.registerDefaultNetworkCallback, KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder, Room.databaseBuilder/Migration). These need a real :app build.

## Consistency pass — training UI

- Every `:core` call site in the group was checked against the code on disk: names, parameter order and nullability. This covers PlanCoordinator (constants, recompute, realizeToday, buildInputs, deloadSuggestion, plannerProposals, recordDeloadDecision, onSessionClosed), ProposalApplier (apply, reject, defer, finalize, markFailed), PlanDiffer.between, Presets.gymFromPreset and Presets.BASE_GYM, EquipmentResolver and GymParams, IncrementResolver.step, SubstitutionEngine.rank, Planner.normalize and trainingAgeOf, ProgressionEngine.findLoadDecision and inSessionBackoff, E1rm.estimate (returns nullable), ProgressSeries, WeeklyLedger.build, rows and carryover, MuscleTiers.assign, RirStack.profileTargetRir, MobilityPlanner.weeklyMinutes, SupplementAdvisor.caffeineCutoffs, MutationValidator.validate with ValidationResult.Invalid, OverrideResolver.active, VolumeAccountant.ofSets, RedFlags, Explanations.of, Units, Weeks, IdGen, CoreJson.stored, and the PlannerConstants fields rdy02*, rdy06SpikeFactor and slp03NightHours.
- Every `when` over an enum or sealed class in the group is exhaustive. This includes TodayNav (9 cases), SessionNav (4), SessionSheet (9), TodaySheet (4), LoadType in usesWeight and PlateCalculator (12 each), LimitationRegion (8), ReadinessBand, KeypadField, SwapReason, RowStatus and ReadinessField.
- R.string: all 233 distinct R.string names used in the group exist in res/values/strings*.xml. The XML files parse, there are no duplicate names, no unescaped apostrophes, only positional format specifiers, and argument counts and types at each call site match the `%n$d`/`%n$s` placeholders. No setup-group string had to be added.
- No androidx.room, okhttp3 or android.util.Log import exists under ui/.
- androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-viewmodel-compose 2.11.0: the `viewModel(key = ..) { initializer }` overload (initializer: CreationExtras.() -> VM) is used in all screens. Believed correct since the 2.6 line.
- androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-compose 2.11.0: collectAsStateWithLifecycle() on StateFlow, and `Flow<AppSettings>.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)`. The Flow is covariant, so T infers as AppSettings?. Used in SessionScreen and ProgressScreen.
- Navigation-compose 2.10.0: type-safe `navController.navigate(route: Any) { popUpTo<T> { inclusive = true } }` (NavOptionsBuilder.popUpTo<T> reified, since 2.8). Used in SessionScreen and SessionSummaryScreen. `toRoute<T>()` and `hasRoute<T>()` in the frozen nav files are the same family.
- androidx.activity:activity-compose 1.13.0: BackHandler(enabled = true) { } in SessionScreen.
- Compose BOM 2026.08.00: UI/foundation 1.12.0 and Material3 1.4.0, with Material Icons 1.7.8. ModalBottomSheet(onDismissRequest, sheetState) and rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true); TopAppBar(title, navigationIcon, actions) is experimental and file-level OptIn is present; DropdownMenu and DropdownMenuItem(text, onClick); LinearProgressIndicator(progress = { Float }); OutlinedTextField(minLines); Scaffold(topBar, bottomBar) { PaddingValues -> }; FilterChip, AssistChip, Switch, RadioButton, Card(colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor)).
- Compose foundation: Modifier.combinedClickable(onClick, onLongClick) under @OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi), which still exists. LazyListScope.items(count: Int) { index -> } is a member function, so no import is needed. horizontalScroll, verticalScroll and rememberScrollState are imported where used.
- Compose runtime: mutableIntStateOf and mutableLongStateOf (runtime 1.5+) with the getValue and setValue delegate imports present where the delegates are used.
- Compose UI: HapticFeedbackType.LongPress via LocalHapticFeedback (believed still present in 1.12); semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }; LocalView.current.keepScreenOn; Modifier.semantics.
- Material icons (extended 1.7.8): Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.ArrowBack, and Icons.Filled.Check, ExpandLess, ExpandMore, Info, MoreVert, SwapHoriz, Timer, Warning, History, FitnessCenter. Filled.Chat and Filled.ShowChart in the frozen BottomBar are deprecated to the AutoMirrored versions, which I expect to be a warning only.
- androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel: ScopedViewModel overrides `onCleared()` (protected open; the override keeps protected visibility). Plain JVM unit tests construct ViewModels without Android classes, because every ViewModel takes a CoroutineDispatcher with a default of Dispatchers.Main.immediate that tests override.
- kotlinx-coroutines 1.11.0: Flow.collect { } as a SAM FlowCollector; merge(vararg), conflate and collectLatest are imported; kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException typealias; Dispatchers.Main.immediate needs kotlinx-coroutines-android, which is declared. Test code uses kotlin.test with kotlin-test-junit, and runTest, StandardTestDispatcher and advanceUntilIdle from kotlinx-coroutines-test.
- kotlinx.serialization 1.11.0: SetDraft and SessionDraftDoc are @Serializable and use WeightUnit, which is a @Serializable enum. They are encoded and decoded with CoreJson.stored.encodeToString(serializer, value). The kotlin.plugin.serialization plugin is applied in app/build.gradle.kts.
- Kotlin 2.4.10: `if`/`else` expressions with `emptyList()`/`emptyMap()` branches rely on type inference from the other branch (ProgressViewModel mobility and volume, ExerciseInfoSheet `how`). Callable references to functions with default parameters are used as non-default function types: `vm::onOpenKeypad` and `vm::onPickSubstitute`. Both are supported since Kotlin 1.4.
- Frozen components were read in full and I found nothing provably broken: Stepper, NumberField, ProposalCard, LineChart, MuscleBandBars, MonthGrid, PlateDiagram, RirChips and RuleTag. Frozen nav and theme files are consistent with the screens in the group.
- Test and fake wiring: FakeRepositories implements every core.repo interface that the tests use. Every Fake* class referenced by any test is defined. TestEnv.deps(...) matches the PlanCoordinator and TrainingDeps constructors on disk. The tests call only public members of the ViewModels.

**Fixes applied by this pass:**

- app/src/main/kotlin/com/gymcoach/app/ui/today/TodaySections.kt (TodayCompute.nutritionStrip): `ma7.lastOrNull { ... }` was called on the nullable `List<ChartPoint>?` from `safely {}`. That is a hard compile error, because the null check on `last` does not smart-cast `ma7`. Changed to `ma7?.lastOrNull { ... }`.
- app/src/main/kotlin/com/gymcoach/app/ui/session/PlateCalculatorSheet.kt (PlateMath.inventory): replaced `(base + if (microplates) MICRO else emptyList()).sortedDescending()` with `(if (microplates) base + MICRO else base).sortedDescending()`. This is a defensive fix. The old form made `List.plus(element)` vs `plus(Iterable)` overload resolution depend on inferring the type of `emptyList()` inside an `if`. The new form has the same result.
- Added `@file:OptIn(androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)` as a safety measure to four files that use FilterChip or AssistChip without it: session/FinishSheet.kt, plan/PlanSections.kt, progress/ProgressSections.kt, progress/ExerciseProgressScreen.kt. Whether chips are still experimental in Material3 1.4.0 is not certain. The opt-in is harmless if they are stable.

**Unresolved / read-only checks:**

- No unresolved compile errors found. The checks were manual only: nothing was compiled, and nothing was verified against the Compose or Navigation API docs (no WebFetch). Uncertain points, all believed fine, are listed in compile_risk_list.

**Fixes applied by this pass:**

- coach/CoachScreen.kt: removed the duplicate `import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable`.
- profile/ProfileScreen.kt: added `@file:OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)`. InputChip is used and its opt-in status in M3 1.4.0 could not be confirmed, so this is a defensive fix.
- coach/MessageBubble.kt, coach/QuickPrompts.kt, coach/ConversationScreen.kt: added the same file-level OptIn. AssistChip is used in all three and the experimental status is unconfirmed. The OptIn is harmless if the API is already stable.
- No other defect was found in the 37 Kotlin files, so no further source edits were made. Checks that came back clean: all 178 distinct `com.gymcoach.*` imports resolve, and all 421 distinct `R.string.*` references exist in res/values. There are no duplicate resource names and every values XML parses. No value has a leading `@` or `?`, an unescaped apostrophe or a malformed `%`, and every `stringResource` call passes the number of format arguments its string declares. All 23 distinct icons used exist, checked against the cached material-icons-extended 1.7.3 jars. Every `when` over a sealed class or enum I traced is exhaustive. No file under ui/ imports androidx.room or okhttp3. Calls from the group into :core and into PlanCoordinator/AppContainer match the callee signatures. The calls from AppNavHost into the group's 22 screens also match.

**Unresolved / read-only checks:**

- Nothing blocks the group. Two points rest on reading the code rather than compiling it. First, I could not confirm whether FilterChip, InputChip and AssistChip are still @ExperimentalMaterial3Api in M3 1.4.0 (the pinned version). Every file that uses them now carries an OptIn, so the risk is closed either way. Second, `Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.Chat` was checked against the 1.7.3 jars, which carry the same icon set as the pinned 1.7.8. It exists there, and the non-mirrored `Icons.Filled.Chat` also exists as a fallback.
- Behaviour, not compile: CoachViewModel.startTurn calls `reload()` in a `finally` block. When the turn job is cancelled (onStop), the first suspension inside reload() throws CancellationException, so that refresh is skipped. onStop() already updates state and calls publishMessages() manually, so I left it unchanged.
- SettingsViewModelsTest.kt (outside this group) uses ConstantsModel, BackendCopy, KeyError, BackendSettingsViewModel and AdvancedConstantsViewModel from this group. Their public signatures are unchanged, so it should still compile, but I did not review it.
